description: Defines the DisplayEventReceiver class and related structures for handling display events such as VSync, hotplug, mode change, and frame rate override in Android's graphics subsystem.

classes.name: DisplayEventReceiver
classes.description: Handles registration and reception of display-related events such as VSync, hotplug, mode change, and frame rate override.

methods.name: DisplayEventReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that creates and registers an event connection with SurfaceFlinger.

methods.name: ~DisplayEventReceiver
methods.description: Destructor that severs the connection with SurfaceFlinger.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Returns the state of the DisplayEventReceiver after construction.

methods.name: getFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor to receive events.

methods.name: getLatestVsyncEventData
methods.description: Retrieves the latest VSync event data.
